title: Precision Gateway: dynamic kernel fanout using tiered quant profiles and calibration curation
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a runtime 'Precision Gateway' that fans out inference requests to FP16/FP8/INT8 execution paths based on per-model quant profiles and live calibration signals. This ticket covers the orchestration layer, decision heuristics, an offline->online calibration curation pipeline, and a validation harness to flag accuracy regressions before rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway routes requests to at least three execution paths (FP16, FP8, INT8) with deterministic fallback on failure
Per-model quant profile metadata is persisted and honored by the gateway decision logic
Calibration curation pipeline produces a confidence score for each profile and stores it in model metadata
Validation harness runs against production-like prompt sets and reports end-to-end metric delta (EM, Rouge-L, or chosen proxy) <= configured thresholds
No single-model P99 latency increase > 10% under representative load when enabling the gateway
Feature gated and rollout-capable via console; can be toggled per-customer and per-route
design_notes: Use a two-stage decision: static policy from quant profile (preferred path) + dynamic signal (cache hit rate, recent accuracy deltas) to decide live path
Profiles: canonical schema includes layer-sensitivity map, per-layer scale/zero-point seeds, calibration dataset fingerprint, and a risk_score from offline calibration
Calibration curation: offline calibrator produces candidates; a curator service runs short online A/B experiments to estimate production drift and assigns confidence
Fallback behavior: on kernel failure or unacceptable output (invalid tokens / model crash), gateway will retry with FP16 then INT8 as last resort; telemetry emitted for each step
Minimize allocation churn: keep warm pools for FP8/INT8 kernels per model shard to avoid cold-start latencies
Telemetry contract: emit tags for model_version, profile_id, path_taken, confidence_score, calibration_fingerprint, accuracy_delta, and scheduled_rollout_id
implementation_steps: Schema: extend model metadata store with quant_profile and calibration_confidence fields
Gateway: implement path selector module with plugin hooks for policy rules and dynamic inputs
Warm pools: add lightweight warm-pool lifecycle manager for small-batch kernels
Curator: implement short-run online validation job that executes candidate profiles against a held-back prompt set and reports metrics
Validation harness: build synthetic and production-like prompt suites; integrate with CI to block rollouts when accuracy regression > threshold
Console: add per-model toggle and rollout controls; surface calibration_confidence and recent accuracy deltas
End-to-end tests: microbench for kernel fanout under load, chaos test for kernel crash/fallback, and accuracy check against golden dataset
Docs & SDK: document quant_profile fields and how to opt-in/out or pin a path in the API
test_plan: Unit tests for selector logic covering policy combinations and confidence thresholds
Integration tests against runtime with mocked kernels for FP16/FP8/INT8 to validate fallback ordering
Load tests simulating 10k rps with mixed sequence lengths to confirm latency SLOs
A/B validation: run curated candidate profiles on 5% of traffic for 24h and compare quality metrics to control
Synthetic adversarial prompts to ensure INT8 path doesn't hallucinate or produce malformed outputs more frequently than allowed threshold
monitoring_metrics: customer_impact.alerts when quality delta > configured threshold
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal canary - enable gateway for staging models and run validation harness
Phase 1: 1% of production traffic for select non-critical customers; monitor metrics for 48h
Phase 2: 10% traffic and expanded prompt coverage; run curator online checks daily
Phase 3: gradual ramp to 50% with per-customer opt-out available; block if any model shows regression > threshold
Full: enable by default for eligible models with documented profile confidence >= 0.8
rollback_plan: Immediate disable via console toggle and automatic global fallback to FP16 for all routed requests. If rollback occurs, run forensic job to capture failed requests and calibration fingerprints and create postmortem with mitigation actions.
dependencies: PM-441 - console rollout controls and UI surface
